rows.notes: Released mission title reused verbatim from missions_019.json (17B has no English/source Part 1 either, per that file's review notes).

rows.en: <operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Now that you're with us, we head for New York, where the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()><thumbnail(250)> is. We can't let the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()> run loose any longer.
rows.notes: Speaker 30090 = Hayato Jin. Kept the source's second book(48) Shin Dragon mention as its own tag (rather than collapsing to a pronoun) so both angle-bracket commands survive in order. Orchestrator: shortened to fit three lines.

rows.en: <operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>With the <book(2)>Baldora Charge<endbook()> advancing too, we also need to pin down where <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> is. This allows no room for complacency.
rows.notes: book(2) Baldora Charge per encyclopedia_021_a.json lock (also used for the wormhole's progress meter).

rows.en: <thumbdown()><topic()><operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>Trouble's cropped up again... We tripped the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>'s tracking net<thumbnail(251)>. The <book(56)>Siberian Railway<endbook()> lies in wait ahead.
rows.notes: Speaker 30100 = Gain Bijou. Shibe-tetsu (source's shortened nickname for the Siberian Railway) rendered as the full locked name per terms_028.json.

rows.en: <operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>We'd like to shake them off and head straight for the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>, but it looks like they've come prepared for us too.
<thumbdown()><operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>Best to take them on here and clear the threat at our backs. No time to waste, so let's finish this fast.

uncertainties.issue: 'This allows no room for complacency' (yodan wo yurusan joukyou da) has no stated subject in the source; kept impersonal rather than supplying 'we'/'it's'.
Compressed 'so soon after you joined us' to 'now that you're with us' to remove 'joined' (lowercase j) and fit the length limit; meaning (this is their first joint operation) preserved.

checked_decisions: Slot 0 title equals missions_019.json '17B Repel Pursuit Force 2'.
Slot 19-23 speaker 30090 confirmed Hayato Jin, 30100 confirmed Gain Bijou via tools/speaker_lookup.py.
Slot 19 'Now that you're with us' for the dropped 'so soon after joining' reading: meaning (this is the first joint operation) preserved; no lowercase j introduced.
Slot 20 'This allows no room for complacency' correctly left subjectless, matching the source's subjectless 'yodan wo yurusan joukyou da'.
Slot 22 'they've come prepared for us too' is a reasonable rendering of 'sono nari no junbi' (prepared accordingly); not an invented addition given context (they are readying to intercept the party).

Tag sequence (operator/speed/book/color/thumbnail/thumbdown/topic) verified identical and in source order for every row via a throwaway script comparing tools/scene_source.py output against each row's en field.
No lowercase j/q found outside locked names; no bare %; no newlines; ASCII only; all rows <=128 visible chars (max 128 at slot 19).
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 20: no stated subject for 'no room for complacency' in the source; impersonal construction kept as in the draft.
